definition: Alexandra Sasha Luccioni (née Vorobyova; born 1990) is a computer scientist specializing in the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and climate change.
details: Her work focuses on quantifying the environmental impact of AI technologies and promoting sustainable practices in machine learning development.

explainer.lead: Sasha Luccioni is an Ukrainian computer scientist (born 1990).

contributions.name: Luccioni briefly worked with the United Nations Global Pulse in 2021, developing tools to monitor COVID-19 misinformation.

timeline.what: Luccioni earned a B.A. in language science from University of Paris III: Sorbonne Nouvelle in 2010.
Luccioni began her professional career at Nuance Communications in 2017, where she focused on natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning (ML) techniques to enhance conversational agents.
Luccioni obtained her PhD in cognitive computing from Université du Québec à Montréal (UQAM) in 2018.
She then joined Morgan Stanley’s AI/ML Center of Excellence in 2018, working on explainable artificial intelligence (AI) and decision-making systems.
